title: INC-9841: Incident On The Support Console
body:
Impact

This report covers an incident on the Support Console that
is ongoing. About 21 customer tickets were linked to it by
Security Office, with Tessaro Labs engaged as the hosting
provider from the first hour.

Timeline

Timeline recorded by Kenji Sato, in order, as of 15 December
2025:
- Monitoring raised a latency alert for the primary cluster
- Error rates were compared against the weekly baseline
- The vendor was engaged through the premium support line

Status

For tracking purposes the incident is ongoing. Report
written by Kenji Sato on 5 October 2025; the next review
falls in the 20:00-21:00 UTC window and goes to the weekly
service meeting.
